outputs: creation previews consume the 4.3 precheck summary and the selected site/session blocks; the plan fingerprint binds resource ids, window, availability, capacity, fees, rules, form deployment and mode without checked_at/source

a changed unit price, total, session window, availability, cancellation rule, capacity, form deployment or project mode invalidates the stored plan with FAILED/PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN and never dispatches at the new values
the project directory mode is checked before any mode-specific page request; a declared mismatch or an unregistered mode is refused with INVALID_ARGUMENTS
cross-project same-named sites are rejected by scene, site and mode checks; the request body is bound to sceneUuid, siteUuid, siteType, sceneUseType, sessionDetailUuid and the exact time span
SPORT_PERSON supports one self ticket only and always hands off CHOOSE_TICKET_AND_QUANTITY; multi-ticket purchases are outside the frozen input schema

amounts stay integer fen; the preview separates quantity, unit price and source-declared total and never multiplies a unit price by an assumed headcount; an unknown total goes to the official settlement page
expected_total_fen is compared with the source payableAmount; a mismatch is SPORTS_FEE_CHANGED and a free plan cannot silently become paid
captcha, form, deployment and official payment paths stay on the official site; the plan becomes AWAITING_OFFICIAL without dispatch and result readback uses own orders/detail
action evidence keeps reservation/approval/payment/refund source values plus canonical status and state_confirmed; pending payment keeps the platform deadline and its declared/not-reported state
refund acceptance (REQUESTED/REFUNDING/PENDING/MANUAL), platform settlement (REFUNDED) and arrived-money verification are separate; refund_arrived_verified is always false
cancel plans bind the own record, scene, sites, time span, reservation/approval/payment/refund states, extended status, amounts and cancelBeforeStart; a changed rule or state invalidates the plan
cancel results require an exact cancelled record with matching extension status, scene, sites and time; a missing record or a partial search is not proof of cancellation
create reconciliation runs only inside a 24-hour window after dispatch and requires exactly one matching record whose detail agrees on extension status, platform status, amount and pay type
short, repeated or changed order pages, two similar records, an unparseable row or a disagreeing detail keep the result UNKNOWN instead of choosing a record
the side-effect ledger records official_request as NOT_SENT before dispatch and SENT once the single-use gate accepts the request; a lost response leaves SENT and is never replayed
repeated execution of the same unresolved plan only re-reads; the synthetic dispatch count stays at one
disabling THU_SPORTS_WRITE stops new plans and execution while order reads, describe and unresolved reconciliation keep working
official jump links are reduced to registered routes; signing query values, foreign hosts and URL credentials never enter a plan, todo or action result
platform evidence excludes member accounts and payment credentials and carries a refresh suggestion for todo/kanban consumers
no new MCP tool or query operation is introduced; the legacy operation names, parameters and fields remain compatible

verified_cases: a free plan binds the precheck snapshot, dispatches once through the exact signed URL, records official_request as SENT and verifies the synthetic remote record on a lost response
a changed unit price, total, session availability, time or cancellation rule makes execute return FAILED/PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN with zero dispatches
the plan binding is stable across different checked_at values but changes when the price or cancel rule changes
a page row from another project is rejected with SPORTS_SCENE_MISMATCH; an unregistered or mismatched mode is refused before any mode-specific page request
person mode always hands off ticket quantity and stays AWAITING_OFFICIAL without dispatch; the preview states one TICKET
official captcha verification keeps the plan AWAITING_OFFICIAL on repeated execute and result
an unknown total is never derived from the unit price; the plan hands off to the official settlement page and does not dispatch
expected_total_fen disagreeing with the source payableAmount is SPORTS_FEE_CHANGED
an unpaid order reports PENDING_PAYMENT with the platform deadline and declared deadline state; the same record with paid + approval pending reports PENDING_APPROVAL and payment_status PAID
repeated execute/result calls on one unresolved plan keep the synthetic dispatch count at one and verify SUCCEEDED only after the record appears
a successful cancel with refund REFUNDING reports refund_accepted=true, refund_settled_by_platform=false and refund_arrived_verified=false
a short own-order page, two similar records, a malformed row or a disagreeing detail keeps the result UNKNOWN; no record is chosen arbitrarily
a delayed order created after plan expiry but within the 24-hour dispatch window is matched; an order created before dispatch is not attributed to the plan
a rate-limited readback keeps UNKNOWN with CHECK_RESULT_ONLY_DO_NOT_RESEND and never dispatches again
a definite not-sent dispatch ends FAILED/REQUEST_NOT_SENT with official_request NOT_SENT and no retry
with THU_SPORTS_WRITE=0, order reads, describe and reconciliation keep working while prepare is refused with SPORTS_WRITES_DISABLED
official URLs lose signing query values; foreign hosts and URL credentials fall back to the personal reservation page
the capability table exposes exactly the two legacy sports operations, one session/ticket per mode and no new tool names
cancel preview amounts stay exact integer fen (12345 -> 123.45) and record the current payment state
cancel preparation requires a complete own-record search; a missing record stays non-success
limits: Offline synthetic verification only: no real campus login, availability read, reservation creation, cancellation, payment or refund was performed.

The sports-action-v1 input schema is frozen in actions.py (4.4): there is no quantity parameter. SPORT_GROUP is one session and SPORT_PERSON one self ticket; multi-ticket, multi-person ticket and reschedule flows must use the official page.

The plan business schema is string-only; quantity/unit/total are separated in the preview text and the source fen values are bound in the fingerprint. Structured amounts are exposed in the result platform.amounts; adding plan-level structured fields needs an actions.py change owned by 4.4/6.1.

Delayed-order reconciliation is bounded to 24 hours after dispatch and requires gmtCreate. A record without gmtCreate or created before dispatch is not attributed to the plan and the result stays UNKNOWN.
A paid plan completed on the official page without expected_total_fen accepts the platform total but reports total_verified=false; it never claims the platform amount was compared with a plan amount.
refund_arrived_verified is always false; refund_settled_by_platform only mirrors the platform refund enum and does not prove the money reached the payer.
Only group reservations with resvProperty=0 can dispatch a cancel directly; person tickets, non-zero resvProperty, paid or unknown-refund orders require the official control page.
sports.py, queries.py, actions.py, action_store.py and mcp_stdio.py were not modified; order reads, precheck and the four status axes remain 4.3/3.2 contracts.

No new error code was registered. An unsupported mode reuses the registered INVALID_ARGUMENTS code; pre-existing unregistered sports-internal codes were left for the overall error-classification audit.
This record does not update the batch gate, acceptance mapping or ownership table status; accepted and batch reconnection are recorded by the remediation stage and the integration owner.
rollback: Set THU_SPORTS_WRITE=0 to stop new plans and execution while keeping order reads, describe and unresolved reconciliation. For a code rollback restore sports_actions.py and sports_transport.py to 37b1605 and delete tests/test_sports_actions.py; do not undo any real reservation or cancellation, do not trigger refunds and do not delete unresolved plans or official references. Added evidence fields are optional and old clients ignore them.
